color.note: Dark only for version one. Warm charcoal neutrals with no blue undertone. Blue and orange belong to the providers and never tint surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: Left navigation ground: projects, chats, usage and profile.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Right Delegated work panel ground.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Main conversation canvas and the titlebar above it. The lightest of the three grounds so the conversation reads as the centre.

tokens.name: surface-code
tokens.usage: Code blocks and command previews set into the transcript or an approval.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for flat rows (chats, tasks, menu items) on any ground; also the quiet card behind notices.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected chat or task row, and the pressed state of flat rows. A fill only; never add a side border.

tokens.name: surface-composer
tokens.usage: Composer, user message bubble, docked approval card and setup cards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised controls sitting on the composer (Stop, secondary buttons), usage meter tracks, avatar, completed step disc.

tokens.name: surface-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, the model picker and the expanded change list. Always with shadow-popover.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Structural separators only: between sections inside a menu or popover. Never around panels, columns or controls.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, body copy and row labels. At least 10:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Meta lines, activity summaries, secondary labels. At least 5.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, section labels, timestamps. Legible (4.5:1+) on sidebar, panel, canvas, hover, selected and composer; use text-secondary on raised and popover.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only; exempt from the contrast floor, always paired with a reason nearby.

tokens.name: codex
tokens.usage: Codex identity: provider label, working ring, usage fill, selected-model check. As text, on every surface (6.8:1+).

tokens.name: codex-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind the selected Codex model row in the picker.

tokens.name: codex-effort-1
tokens.usage: Lightning and slider fill at the lowest Codex effort. Icon only (3.2:1+ on raised).

tokens.name: codex-effort-2
tokens.usage: Codex effort step two.

tokens.name: codex-effort-3
tokens.usage: Codex effort middle step; the plain Codex blue.

tokens.name: codex-effort-4
tokens.usage: Codex effort step four.

tokens.name: codex-effort-5
tokens.usage: Highest Codex effort; the only step that gets the moving highlight.

tokens.name: claude
tokens.usage: Claude identity: provider label, working ring, usage fill, selected-model check. As text, on every surface (5.2:1+).

tokens.name: claude-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind the selected Claude model row in the picker.

tokens.name: claude-effort-1
tokens.usage: Lightning and slider fill at the lowest Claude effort. Icon only (3:1+ on raised).

tokens.name: claude-effort-2
tokens.usage: Claude effort step two.

tokens.name: claude-effort-3
tokens.usage: Claude effort middle step; the plain Claude orange.

tokens.name: claude-effort-4
tokens.usage: Claude effort step four.

tokens.name: claude-effort-5
tokens.usage: Highest Claude effort; the only step that gets the moving highlight.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Added-line counts (+100). Always printed with its + sign, so it never relies on hue.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Removed-line counts, error titles and the failed glyph. Always with a sign, an icon or a word.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Waiting for you: the filled attention glyph. Deliberately neutral so it never reads as a provider.

tokens.name: on-attention
tokens.usage: The exclamation mark inside the attention glyph.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary action fill: Send, Allow once, Continue. One per view.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label or icon on the action fill (13.6:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid after a 2px gap. At least 9.6:1 on every surface, so it is never confused with the selected fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the Delegated work sheet in a narrow window.

families.sans: Geist, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist in three weights: 400, 500, 600. Bundle the OFL font files with the native app so macOS and Windows render the same.

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: Empty new-chat greeting and first-run setup heading only.

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: The open chat's title in the chat header.

styles.name: t-heading
styles.usage: Panel headers, menu titles, Markdown headings in the transcript.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: The spacing is updated. Claude is checking the keyboard flow.
styles.usage: Agent replies and user messages in the transcript.

styles.name: t-ui
styles.usage: Rows, menu items, control labels, plan steps.

styles.name: t-ui-strong
styles.usage: Task titles, provider labels, button labels, unread chat titles.

styles.name: t-small
styles.usage: Meta lines, activity summaries, the change strip, effort label.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Section labels, usage meter labels, keyboard hints. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: t-code
styles.usage: Code blocks, commands in approvals, inline code in replies.

styles.name: t-mono-small
styles.usage: File paths in the change list, engine versions on the setup screen.

spacing.note: 4px base. Group with space, not lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a provider name and its dot separator; inside keyboard hints.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label, and between controls inside one toolbar cluster (the model group uses 6px, see README).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row inset from the column edge; bottom inset of composer and profile from the window edge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Composer inner padding; gap between plan steps and a reply.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between turns in the transcript; between sidebar sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Chat header to first message.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of an empty state to its heading.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Setup screen section spacing.

radius.note: Soft rectangles; the composer is the roundest thing on screen.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard hints, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small icon buttons (28px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, buttons, 32px icon buttons, model control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, code blocks, notices, task cards, setup cards.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: User message bubble.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The composer and the docked approval card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatar, send button, meter tracks, switches.

shadow.note: Three elevations plus the focus ring. Lists and panels stay flat; shadows are for things that float or take input.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Stop and secondary buttons sitting on the composer.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: Composer and docked approval card.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, model picker, expanded change list, task sheet.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on any control or row: a 2px canvas-colour gap, then 2px of the focus colour. Follows the element's radius.

size.note: Logical points. Validate against native scaling on both platforms.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Window titlebar and drag region; holds macOS traffic lights or Windows caption buttons.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Left navigation width.

tokens.name: size-panel
tokens.usage: Delegated work panel width. Collapses first when the window narrows.

tokens.name: size-column
tokens.usage: Max width shared by the transcript and the composer.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Chat rows, project rows, menu items.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and icon buttons in the composer toolbar.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in cards and headers.

tokens.name: size-composer-min
tokens.usage: Composer minimum height: two lines of input plus the toolbar.

tokens.name: size-inset-bottom
tokens.usage: Gap between the composer (and the profile row) and the window's lower edge.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Profile avatar.

duration.note: Short, interruptible, and only when something real changed.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Pressed feedback on buttons and rows.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover fills, state label swaps.

tokens.name: dur-standard
tokens.usage: Panel and popover disclosure, change list expand.

tokens.name: dur-settle
tokens.usage: A completed step settling into its check, once.

tokens.name: dur-crossfade
tokens.usage: Activity summary replaced by a newer provider event.

tokens.name: loop-working
tokens.usage: One turn of the working ring.

tokens.name: loop-breathe
tokens.usage: One breath of a running child task in the panel.

tokens.name: loop-shimmer
tokens.usage: Highlight sweep on the highest effort step, only while the picker is open.

tokens.name: loop-streak
tokens.usage: Proposed: one pass of the light through the StreakLabel activity words. Linear, continuous.

tokens.name: step-working
tokens.usage: Proposed: one hard step of the BuildGrid working mark. Steps, not tweens, so a native renderer draws about six frames a second.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or changes state.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Popovers and panels closing.
